lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The centroids exhibit a regular, grid-like spacing with higher density in the mid-lateral region compared to the dorsal area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of circular blobs, creating a lattice pattern where the blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient from the superior to inferior aspect of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, low-luminance circular focal point is visible on the surface of the fourth gill slit, indicating a localized surface anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal organisms are visible trailing ventrally to the pectoral fin.
